# get_track_meta { #geneinfo.ucsc.get_track_meta }

```python
geneinfo.ucsc.get_track_meta(track_name, assembly)
```

Return the UCSC metadata dict for a single track (searching subtracks).

## Parameters {.doc-section .doc-section-parameters}

<code>[**track_name**]{.parameter-name} [:]{.parameter-annotation-sep} [[str](`str`)]{.parameter-annotation}</code>

:   UCSC track or subtrack name, as listed by :func:`search_tracks`.

<code>[**assembly**]{.parameter-name} [:]{.parameter-annotation-sep} [[str](`str`)]{.parameter-annotation}</code>

:   Genome assembly, e.g. ``'hg38'``.

## Returns {.doc-section .doc-section-returns}

<code>[]{.parameter-name} [:]{.parameter-annotation-sep} [[dict](`dict`)]{.parameter-annotation}</code>

:   The track's entry from the UCSC ``/list/tracks`` endpoint, e.g. ``type``, ``shortLabel``, ``longLabel``. Subtracks also carry ``_parent``, the name of their container.

## Raises {.doc-section .doc-section-raises}

<code>[:]{.parameter-annotation-sep} [[KeyError](`KeyError`)]{.parameter-annotation}</code>

:   If the track does not exist in the assembly.
